item.title: UK sanctions Myanmar's president and military leaders over genocide
item.body: The UK has imposed sanctions on Myanmar's president and military leaders over the Rohingya genocide. Ed Miliband says new laws will also be passed to stop the supply of aviation fuel to the country.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🤝 UK sanctions Myanmar's president and military leaders over genocide

The UK has imposed sanctions on Myanmar's president and military leaders over the Rohingya genocide. Ed Miliband says new laws will also be passed to stop the supply of aviation fuel to the country.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 23 November, 20:20
